args.body: Uberon refuses the requested structure: "wing" is never_in_taxon Glires. It does allow styliform cartilage and styliform element here for the same function.

conflicts.label: wing
conflicts.note: Uberon asserts never_in_taxon "Glires" for "wing" (on the term, a superclass, or a whole it is part of), and the NCBI taxonomy places Mus musculus inside that clade. The structure is kept out of the blueprint and reported here; nothing in the hierarchy stands for it.
conflicts.axiom: Uberon asserts never_in_taxon "Glires" for "wing" (on the term, a superclass, or a whole it is part of), and the NCBI taxonomy places Mus musculus inside that clade.

function_alternatives.reading: the ontology refuses "wing" for Mus musculus and at the same time records 2 structure(s) it allows for Mus musculus that it links to "flight". Naming one of those instead is the next thing to try.

counterexamples.reading: "wing" is asserted never_in_taxon Glires. Pteromyini is inside that clade, and this repository's own inventory writes its common name as "Pteromyini", "flying squirrels", "flying squirrels" -- a name for flight. Either that name is wrong or the axiom is too wide. This tool does not decide which.

conflicts.axiom_status: contradicted by the project inventory: see counterexamples
conflicts.substitution_warning: "wing" was asked for and refused, and 2 structures are in the blueprint in its place -- "styliform cartilage", "styliform element" -- promoted from the function word "flight" rather than named by the description. READ THE HIERARCHY ACCORDINGLY: it is not the design that was requested, and the presence of a flight-related structure in it is not the ontology accepting the request.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
